entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio Vargiu was an Italian field hockey player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1960 Summer Olympics. Vargiu died from injuries sustained after being hit by a motorcycle in Rome, on 30 November 2025, at the age of 88.
